correctness.rationale: Complete finite matching recursion yields 272 one-factors partitioned into eight orbits under 384 cube symmetries. Separate Python direct independence-and-domination and C++ complement-maximal-clique programs reconstruct and exhaustively trace all 2^16 supports for each orbit. Both reproduce all eight face and facet polynomials, VC5=40, pure=16, and the C++ checks an explicit GP(8,3) graph isomorphism. Independent audit not performed.
